description:
The ~12-line clone between elixir_mode.ex:304 and compiler.ex:873 is the {init, kw} recipe for Enum.all?/any?. It is a shared semantic fact (agreement invariant), not twinned algorithms — backends stay separate.
Add Defk.Builtins.bool_reduce/1 (:all? / :any? returning {init, kw}) and call it at both sites. Defk.Builtins is the established cross-backend shared-fact module. Keep --max-clones 0.
title: ExDNA: extract shared Enum.all?/any? accumulator recipe
